groups.label: Describes the messenger toward the believers
Describes believers' relation to one another

items.dominant: Describes Allah or the Lord in 114 of 116 uses

outside.how: Applied to the messenger; بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ names the group toward whom the quality is directed.
Plural description of the believers, followed by بَيْنَهُمْ to describe their relation within the group.
